long_biography.plain_text:
Smart Source grew by combining outsourced print production with centralised procurement and technology. Thomas D'Agostino Jr. built the company around a national supplier network, software and brand-management services that consolidate clients' purchasing.

Acquisitions became an important expansion tool. Purchases of regional distributors added customer relationships, specialist capabilities and geographic reach, while Smart Source retained local teams and connected them to its broader platform. The model gives clients one purchasing system instead of a fragmented network of printers and product suppliers. D'Agostino has remained chief executive and owner throughout that expansion.
